vendor.name: OSH Park
vendor.notes: Public REST API. Bare-board only — no assembly. Payment is by emailed link, not card-on-file. Boards are always purple (their signature ENIG-on-purple-mask process).

rotation_quirks.notes: Bare-board only — no pick-and-place, no rotation concerns.

Super Swift days corrected 5-7 → 4-6. Medium Run + After Dark services not modeled; min_qty=3 is service-specific (Medium Run 2L is multiples of 10).
